date_note: Leak-site listing seen Nov 18; no intrusion date given.
title: The Gentlemen ransomware group lists Nvidia on its leak site
summary: The Gentlemen ransomware group listed Nvidia on its extortion site on November 18, with the message "DATA INFO - SOON" and a countdown of about 234 hours before a threatened data release. The listing shows no samples or evidence and does not say what was taken. Nvidia has not confirmed an intrusion or commented. This is an unverified attacker claim.
plain: A ransomware gang says it hacked Nvidia and threatens to leak data in about ten days. It has shown no proof, and Nvidia has not confirmed it.
exec: An unconfirmed claim against a major company; no evidence of a breach has been published.
action: No action needed; for awareness. Nvidia partners should watch for official statements and treat unsolicited messages about the claim with caution.

validation.note: IBTimes and the ransomware.live listing report the group's claim; Nvidia has not responded. Cybernews and Cybersecurity News pages were blocked or empty.
